modes.frozen_lineup: Week-1 lineup selected from preseason projections and never changed; no waivers.
modes.weekly_lineups: Weekly start/sit decisions use preseason plus only prior observed results; no waivers.
modes.lineups_plus_waivers: Weekly start/sit decisions plus one conservative same-position waiver move per team/week.

pairing: Identical season, seed, and draft slot across strategies and management modes.
